# Abdullah Automations

> AI automation agency run by Abdullah. Builds AI agents (website chat, WhatsApp, Instagram and voice) that answer leads 24/7 and book appointments, AI automations for follow-ups, reminders, CRM updates and reviews, and premium custom websites. Fixed-price projects; websites from $1,500, automation from $1,200, AI agents from $2,500.

## Services
- [AI automation services](https://abdullahautomations.com/ai-automation-services/): lead capture, follow-ups, reminders, review requests, CRM and reporting automations
- [AI agents for business](https://abdullahautomations.com/ai-agents/): chat, WhatsApp, Instagram and voice agents that qualify leads and book appointments
- [Website design services](https://abdullahautomations.com/website-design-services/): custom premium websites with video, booking and SEO
